observations: English context note for could_not_apply says the countdown is suppressed 'only when explicit apply_outcome.retryable is false'. In code, applyOutcome() normalises retryable as value.retryable === true, and hasPermanentCredentialOutcome() tests (retryable ?? typed.applyOutcome.retryable) === false, so an apply_outcome object that OMITS retryable is also treated as permanent. Fail-closed and consistent with the backend rule that retryable is the only Try-again signal; the note's word 'explicit' is imprecise. No translation is affected; not counted against any locale. (Recorded in every locale receipt of this audit; not counted.)
